scope: moderate-load peer latency; separate Caddy and HAProxy comparisons; no near-saturation claim
unchanged_selection: floor(0.5 * lower candidate/HAProxy warmed usefulRPS median) per H1/H2 and c16/c128; Caddy never changes the rate

failure_policy.caddy_valid_row_underdelivery: preserve row and delivery failure, continue unchanged schedule and HA matrix; mark that Caddy cell capacity-confounded and not passed
failure_policy.correctness_or_instrumentation_failure: fail closed with attempted rows/logs retained

default_mode: original 24-row candidate/HAProxy comparison remains available; extension opt-in
